descriptions.d16c_hud_backing_colour_8011b188: Look up the team, load the Text.Backing resource for its colour (red, blue, green, yellow, turquoise, pink; green otherwise) into the HUD backing handle (+32), reserve three vertices and indices, set unit scale, and fill index i, uv (5,16), position (15,0,0) and the two per-vertex pairs (i*10/32, 0) and (0.3125, 1) for the three vertices.
